title: C-6 — Run manifest
description:
One JSON per run, written by the launcher BEFORE the run and finalised after. F-20: every experiment reproducible from a single config file plus a seed.

`vehicle` is 'hardware' or 'simulator', and F-24 requires every simulated figure to be labelled. Make the figure scripts READ THIS FIELD and stamp the plot automatically — labelling by hand fails exactly once, in the final report.

vehicle.description: F-24: figure scripts read this and stamp simulated plots automatically.

trace_sha256.description: The trace's identity everywhere downstream. Replay client verifies before t0.

warmup_s.description: Drives is_warmup in C-5, computed from the trace's intended_offset_s in BOTH vehicles.

cost_model_snapshots.description: node_id -> C-3 snapshot_id. Which snapshot each node's estimate came from.

items.description: Everything runtime-specific — ignore_eos, min_tokens/max_tokens, enable_prefix_caching=False, llama.cpp slot reuse disabled — is set once at engine construction and recorded HERE, so the settings that eliminate your confounds are auditable from the results.

f18_status.description: 'partial' when the pinned engine version does not expose the prefill/decode split. Record it here rather than faking the split.

send_lag_violations.description: Non-zero => run marked invalid and NOT analysed.
